content:
The leaf is entirely yellowed/tan-brown and appears withered. There are small dark spots scattered across the surface, and the leaf margins show irregular brown lesions, some with a slightly sunken or irregular outline. No white powdery coating (rules out Powdery_Mildew), no black sooty encrustation (rules out Sooty_Mould), no prominent gum or twig dieback visible (Die_Back primarily affects twigs/bark).

The irregular, oval-to-circular dark brown spots scattered across the leaf surface, including near the margins, align with Anthracnose description: irregular/oval-shaped spots all over the leaf surface, with semicircular lesions on margins. The overall browning and necrosis of the leaf is consistent with advanced anthracnose infection.
